description: AGSC-05-27's closed object-property list admits exactly two reachability edges beyond the Link keys: asc:source (from sources[], AGSC-05-14) and asc:review (from verified[], AGSC-05-15), added at V5-1 S7-01 so a Source or Review fragment IRI is reachable from its item without string-parsing (AGSC-05-23 forbids relying on entailment). Both edges MUST be present when the item carries both a sources[] entry and a verified[] entry.
